Move an install to the newest version in its range, or to a new range with --range.

Components already placed in paywalls keep their version until they are moved in the editor.

Usage:
  voidhash registry update <component> [flags]

Arguments:
  component  The registry component's id, such as acme/wheel-picker

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line
      --range <range>      Version range: *, an exact version, ^1.2.3 or ~1.2.3
  -y, --yes                Accept the capabilities and changes the review shows

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash registry update acme/wheel-picker
  voidhash registry update acme/wheel-picker --range ^2.0.0 --yes
